checks: Persisted quote/decision counts reconcile with summary

interpretation: Performance and latest-only scheduling demonstrated during a short sample. No profitability claim: Jev made zero buy/sell decisions. The 18 tests, not the live Jev run, exercised simulated buying and selling. No perpetual task or automation was started.
knownLimitations: Keep also waits for the next quote to settle reference strategies, so full-cycle spacing includes that wait as well as inference; it is not pure model latency

No production reconnect, risk management, long-run profitability, or model-version stability validation
